notablePrerequisites: Grim Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Grim Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 and 3.
